messages:
lucy (CS): quick draft: a 1-page 'low-touch renewal triage' we can run in 15m. goal: stabilize UX for mobile chat widgets (high variance prompts) before renewal call. putting checklist + mini playbook below, asking for edits.

arjun (ENG): high-level looks good. for mobile widgets note: prefer lower batch size and enable streaming by default. propose runtime defaults for this doc.

arjun (ENG): ```
# mobile-chat field defaults
cache:
  enabled: true
  prefix_ttl_ms: 20000
batching:
  max_batch_size: 8
  timeout_ms: 6
streaming: true
# for highly interactive flows trim max_batch_size to 4
```

mica (CS Ops): add an explicit pre-warm with jitter to avoid thundering herd: push top-6 prompts at 6 qps for 40s with 5% jitter; then warm-run 100 synth sessions at 2 qps for 3m. capture traces and these telemetry keys: ["lat_p50","lat_p95","cache_hit_rate","tokens_per_req","error_rate","avg_batch_size"].

evie (DE): UX suggestion: top-line decision ladder (single line): "cache_hit_rate < 20% -> enable client prefill; avg_tokens > 350 -> trim context or request quantized variant; p95 > 900ms -> lower batch timeout or switch to streaming-first." keeps it scannable.

triage-bot: reminder: attach last-6 warm-run traces to tenant ticket before enablement call.

lucy (CS): draft 15-min customer script: 0:00-1:00 goals + success metric; 1:00-5:00 demo cold vs warmed (show latency + tokens); 5:00-9:00 walk runtime snippet + pre-warm steps; 9:00-13:00 review telemetry and flag top risk; 13:00-15:00 pick mitigation and assign eng owner.

arjun (ENG): add quick rollback line: set routing.fallback=quantized-small for 12-24h while investigating, monitor cache_hit_rate and lat_p95.

mica (CS Ops): short troubleshooting table for the one-pager: "p95 > 1s -> reduce max_batch_size or enable streaming; cache_hit_rate < 10% -> inspect prompt set and enable client prefill; error_rate spike -> collect 3 sample req/resp + escalate to eng-oncall."

lucy (CS): perfect. i'll turn into a printable one-pager with checkboxes: prefill done, warm-run done, traces attached, telemetry snapshot, mitigation chosen, eng owner assigned. will post PDF to ticket and ping #cs when ready. thanks all :thumbsup:
